name: Entity Page Title Manage Display
description: For complex entity page title on full page display this module add a dedicated view mode to manage the title display.
project_description: Entity Page Title Manage Display adds a dedicated "Page Title" view mode to every entity type that has a view builder. When a site builder configures that view mode for a bundle on its Manage display page, the module renders the entity in that view mode and uses it to replace the output of the core "Page title" block on the entity's canonical, preview and revision pages. This lets site builders control how the page title (H1 area) is composed and formatted — for example changing the title field formatter, or adding extra fields such as a cover image or subtitle alongside the title — without a custom module or theme override. It provides no configuration form of its own; all customisation happens through core's Manage display UI.
